entities.summary: Livonian Order, a political institution in Estonia during Northern Crusades & Danish Estonia (1227–1346). Grew from Founding of Tallinn (Castrum Danorum) by the Danes and Northern Crusade. Led to the emergence of Teutonic Order and St George's Night Uprising.
